name: Fenwick's Eel-Weir
blurb: Rotting wicker fish-traps wedged between mossy oak pilings below the Sunken Ford.
discovered_line: Broken courier tubes and gnoll shields bob against the weir stakes.

name: Old Border Mint
blurb: Charred stone assay-house where Salt-Tithe clerks once stamped brass tax-tokens.
discovered_line: Cold ash fills the smelting crucibles; stamped lead seals litter the cobbles.

name: Drowned Willow Sink
blurb: Knee-deep black peat hollow choked with weeping willows and bobbing marsh-gas.
discovered_line: Pale green lanterns drift ten paces ahead, luring boots off the boardwalk.

name: Ravenwatch Guard-Cellar
blurb: Drafty stone basement beneath the signal tower, stacked with moldering levy-mail.
discovered_line: A hidden trapdoor behind the wine racks leads down into older masonry.

name: Third Lantern Post
blurb: Iron-caged oil beacon bolted into sheer limestone halfway up Lantern Passage.
discovered_line: The wick sputters blue in dead calm, throwing lunging claw-shadows on the slate.

name: Greywood Water-Mill
blurb: Jammed timber sawmill choked with wet sawdust and overturned supply wagons.
discovered_line: Rusted haulage chains swing silently from the crane boom above.

name: Craghorn Watershed Saddle
blurb: Wind-scoured granite ridge dividing two ice-shadowed alpine defiles.
discovered_line: Two ancient weather-cairns stand cold and unlit against driving sleet.

name: Alder Chalk Bluff
blurb: Steep white-clay embankment overlooking the sole wagon bridge across the Alder.
discovered_line: Broken arrow-shafts bristle from the turf like dead winter grass.

name: Old Quarry Glass-Kilns
blurb: Abandoned stone furnaces fused inside with translucent green silica slag.
discovered_line: Heavy tusk-gouges score the birch trunks ringing the slag heaps.

name: Ashbrook South Ditch
blurb: Muddy drainage trench outside the burned manor walls, lined with fresh cairns.
discovered_line: Splintered siege-rams lie half-buried in trampled turnip rows.

name: Whale-Rib Stockade Gate
blurb: Sun-bleached leviathan jawbones lashed with rawhide above Redmarsh's mud moat.
discovered_line: Alkali dust cakes every timber; sentries squint through green-tinted glass.

name: East Jawbone Sniper-Blind
blurb: Slotted sandstone bunker perched eighty feet above the eastern caravan notch.
discovered_line: Charcoal tally-marks cover the lintel, counting every taxed water-skin.

name: Bracken Hoodoo Maze
blurb: Labyrinth of wind-carved red pillars and thorny scrub prone to blinding haboobs.
discovered_line: Signal mirrors flash sporadically from isolated boulder rings in the grit.

name: Highgate Dry Arroyo
blurb: Cracked clay streambed winding directly beneath Highgate Watch's timber catwalks.
discovered_line: Shattered clay firepots and charred scaling ladders litter the gully.

name: Third Quartz Monolith
blurb: Thirty-foot spire of primeval crystal split down its core by crimson blood-wards.
discovered_line: Static crackles off iron helms; flattened grass forms a dead ring around it.

name: The Bitter Milestone Well
blurb: Covered limestone trough beside the sunken corduroy road across the salt-pan.
discovered_line: Thick green scum and dead beetles float atop the stagnant brine.

name: Redrock Canyon Vault
blurb: Vaulted sandstone cellar hidden behind a narrow slot canyon in the dry hills.
discovered_line: Burst grain sacks spill golden wheat across scorched silver-scales.

name: The Twelve Megaliths
blurb: Sunken willow ring of black standing stones weeping bile-green miasma.
discovered_line: Bone chimes clack in still air around bubbling clay cauldrons.

name: Deep Quarry Slave-Pens
blurb: Chained timber cages bolted into black ironstone ledges above a flooded pit.
discovered_line: Broken shackles and discarded quarry-picks rattle in the updraft.

name: Crossroads Milestone
blurb: Weathered obelisk carved with four imperial distances at the junction of desert tracks.
discovered_line: Chiseled-out glyphs and decoy rock-cairns point toward alkali sinkholes.

name: Greywash Tidal Flats
blurb: Sucking black silt banks exposed twice daily between Oakhaven's piers and the reef.
discovered_line: Grounded ironclad pontoons tilt crookedly in the kelp.

name: Cliffside Cinder Vents
blurb: Steaming basalt fissures above Oakhaven where ground sand fused into black glass.
discovered_line: Sulfur fumes blister exposed skin while cracked ward-pillars cool.

name: The Split Tooth Crag
blurb: Razor-backed granite needle dividing the coastal road between twin arbalest forts.
discovered_line: Rusted iron cages sway from chains beneath the customs semaphore.

name: Ruined Chapel Nave
blurb: Roofless stone abbey sheltering canvas hospital tents behind rain-slick walls.
discovered_line: Lanterns glow through vinegar-stained canvas as hounds howl in the bracken.

name: Drowned Lighthouse Stair
blurb: Tilted spiral stair climbing above a half-submerged First-Empire sea-fortress.
discovered_line: Atlantic breakers thunder through cracked embrasures twenty feet below.

name: Hourglass Shingle Spit
blurb: Narrow gravel bar linking Iron-Gate Watchtower to the mainland at low water.
discovered_line: White surf climbs steadily over shrinking dry stone with every wave.

name: High-Orchard Terraces
blurb: Ash-choked apple groves terraced below a pale chalk watchtower.
discovered_line: Gnarled black trunks creak in sea fog, hung with whispering skulls.

name: Riverlock Capstan Island
blurb: Stone redoubt wedged between roaring canal floodgates and iron counterweights.
discovered_line: Massive bronze gears groan under fifty tons of backed-up river water.

name: Baron Vane's Vault Lift
blurb: Iron-grated counterweight hoist descending from the manor hall into sea-caves.
discovered_line: Gold ingots lie spilled beside smashed strongboxes and dropped halberds.

name: Harborwatch Culverin Wall
blurb: Smoke-blackened stone seawall bristling with bronze coastal artillery above burning piers.
discovered_line: Tarred hulls roar like floating furnaces across the choppy black bay.

name: Obsidian Landing Coves
blurb: Crescent beaches of crushed volcanic glass choked with drifting grey ash.
discovered_line: Yellow sulfur crust steams ten paces inland from the boiling surf.

name: Highcrest Redoubt
blurb: Jagged basalt plateau overlooking the scorched imperial highway into the caldera.
discovered_line: Freshly dug trenches and iron stakes anchor the vanguard's first camp.

name: West Focusing Crag
blurb: Lightning-lashed obsidian spire housing a humming violet capacitor prism.
discovered_line: Blue static arcs between iron helms whenever the crystal chimes.

name: Greystone East Sally-Port
blurb: Pumice-mortared basalt gatehouse scarred by demonic siege-catapult impacts.
discovered_line: Glowing slag-craters smoke across the glacis outside the iron bars.

name: Ashveil Summit Portal
blurb: Narrow switchback stair carved into obsidian cliffs beneath a flickering rift-gate.
discovered_line: Violet sparks trail across charred grimoires abandoned on the steps.

name: The Unquenched Jaw
blurb: Open magma-veined fissure straddling the western mana-cannon bastion.
discovered_line: White-hot slag spits from floor cracks beside chained iron anvils.

name: Magnetic Iron Narrows
blurb: Thirty-pace defile cut straight through raw magnetic ore between spiked portcullises.
discovered_line: Iron scabbards tug sideways against the cliffs while crossbows click above.

name: Citadel Iron Drawbridge
blurb: Six-inch-chained iron span suspended above a sluggish river of molten basalt.
discovered_line: Murder-holes gape blackly above the gatehouse winches.

name: Three-Roads Watch
blurb: Star-shaped ash-plain fort locking down all three approaches to the inner caldera.
discovered_line: Three converging dust plumes mark relief columns marching through soot.

name: The Threshold Nave
blurb: Geometric obsidian hall dominated by twin doors of pale silver and weeping fire.
discovered_line: Headless statues stand silent vigil beside the cooling Anchor Seals.
